haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes. If the order does not claim it in time, the hold expires and the stock goes back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Before. Inventory reserves every line all or nothing. If one line is short, nothing is reserved, no charge is made, and the order is REJECTED_OUT_OF_STOCK.
haiku-low.q3: The order id is sent as the idempotency key, so the provider treats a retried charge request as the same single charge.
haiku-low.q4: Payment refunds the full amount automatically, the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK, and the customer is emailed. Which service sends that email is not yet assigned.
haiku-low.q5: Cleared by the Cart service only after OrderConfirmed. On any checkout failure the cart is left unchanged.
haiku-low.q6: NOT STATED for what moves checkout between steps. The Order service stores order status, which is the record of progress.
haiku-low.q7: The provider sends a webhook over HTTP to the Payment service. How Payment passes success on to Inventory and Order is NOT STATED.
haiku-low.q8: Payment records each webhook event id when first handled and ignores repeats. An order never moves back to an earlier status, so it cannot be confirmed twice.
haiku-low.q9: Inventory releases the hold, triggered by Payment's PaymentDeclined event. Releasing does nothing if the hold has already expired.
haiku-low.q10: Inventory first tries to reserve every line again. If all lines are reserved, it confirms and fulfils; if not, the full amount is refunded and the order cancelled.
haiku-low.q11: The refund is stored as PENDING_RETRY and retried with the same refund key until accepted. Repeated failures alert a person. Tracked in Payment's refund records.
haiku-low.q12: The OrderConfirmed event, published by the Order service, causes the Cart service to clear the cart.

sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes. If the order doesn't claim it, the hold expires (a background timer releases it) and the stock goes back on sale.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved before any charge. If one line is short, nothing is reserved (all or nothing), no charge is made, the order becomes REJECTED_OUT_OF_STOCK, the customer sees which items are short, and the cart is unchanged.
sonnet.q3: The idempotency key (the order id) sent with every charge request; the provider treats a repeated request with the same key as one charge.
sonnet.q4: The full amount is refunded automatically via Payment, the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK, and the customer is emailed.
sonnet.q5: The cart is cleared only after the order is CONFIRMED (on the OrderConfirmed event). On every failure branch the cart is left unchanged so the customer can retry.
sonnet.q6: NOT STATED as a single coordinator. Per the document, each step starts when the prior step finishes or a message (HTTP call, event, webhook) arrives. The order's progress is recorded in the Order service's status (RESERVING, AWAITING_PAYMENT, etc.); Payment stores charge attempt/refund status and Inventory stores holds.
sonnet.q7: The provider sends a webhook (HTTP message) to the Payment service. Payment then triggers the follow-on steps (publishes PaymentDeclined on decline; Inventory claims stock, publishes StockClaimed, then Order confirms on success). Exact transport from Payment to Order is not fully specified.
sonnet.q8: Each webhook has a unique event id; Payment records the ids it has handled. A repeat id is acknowledged and ignored with no state change. Also, an order never moves back to an earlier status.
sonnet.q9: The hold is released (does nothing if already expired). Trigger: Payment stores the attempt as DECLINED and publishes the PaymentDeclined event; the order becomes PAYMENT_FAILED.
sonnet.q10: Inventory checks whether every line can be reserved again. If yes, it re-reserves, turns the new hold into sold stock, and the order is CONFIRMED. If not, the full amount is refunded and the order is CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK.
sonnet.q11: The refund is stored in Payment as PENDING_RETRY and retried with the same refund key until the provider accepts; repeated failures alert a person. The order stays CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK until the refund is stored as REFUNDED. Tracked in Payment's refund records.
sonnet.q12: The OrderConfirmed event, published by Order; the Cart service clears the cart upon receiving it.
